problem_description: The system is working and I would like a seasonal tune-up before the weather changes.
The AC stopped cooling this morning and the indoor temperature is now about 94 degrees.
I submitted this a few minutes ago but want to make sure it was received.
The unit runs but the rooms are not cooling evenly and the airflow seems weak.
The thermostat screen is blank even after replacing the batteries and checking the breaker.
I am not sure what service I need. The house feels uncomfortable sometimes.
Four rental units in the same building have lost cooling and tenants are reporting high indoor temperatures.
I would like information about the annual plan and what is included.
There is very little airflow in the back bedroom and the vent makes a rattling sound.
The AC is making a loud noise and cooling less than usual. Please confirm someone can come today.
